title: Prayer Hall Expansion
description:
The temple’s prayer hall is the heart of daily worship and the temple’s largest festival gatherings — but the congregation has outgrown it. On major festival nights like Maha Shivaratri and Diwali, devotees already fill the hall well past comfortable capacity, with many standing in doorways and hallways to take part.

This project extends the prayer hall itself, adding meaningful additional floor space for prayer, seating, and festival celebration.

How This Helps
The temple: A larger hall lets the temple host its full congregation for every festival, without turning devotees away or asking them to worship from outside the room. It also gives the temple room to grow rather than reaching capacity again in a few years.

The immediate community: Families can attend festival celebrations together, comfortably, rather than splitting up or arriving hours early to find space. Elderly devotees and those with young children benefit especially from more breathing room.

The wider community: A larger, more welcoming hall means Shri Shiv Dham can better serve as a gathering place for Central Florida’s whole Hindu community — including guests from other temples and traditions who join for major celebrations.

title: New Restrooms and Showers
description:
Many devotees come straight to the temple from a full day of work, or stay through the night for extended prayer, offerings, and vigils like Maha Shivaratri. Right now, the temple’s facilities aren’t built for that — this project adds proper restrooms and shower facilities so devotees can freshen up before entering worship, and stay comfortably through longer observances.

How This Helps
The temple: Proper facilities make it realistic for the temple to host overnight vigils and multi-day festivals without asking devotees to go without basic comforts. It also means the temple can better welcome working professionals who can only make it to the temple directly from their jobs.

The immediate community: Devotees who work long hours, commute from a distance, or care for family members won’t have to choose between attending worship and basic comfort. Overnight observances become realistic for more families, not just those who live nearby.

The wider community: As the temple’s role as a full-day community gathering space grows — hosting fairs, camps, and multi-day celebrations — these facilities become part of what makes Shri Shiv Dham a place people can spend a whole day, not just a quick visit.

title: Administrative Office and Library
description:
As the temple’s programs have grown — Bal Vihar, Sadvidya Pathshala, language and music classes, and the annual summer camp — so has the need for a real administrative home base and a proper space for educational materials. This project creates a dedicated administrative office, along with a books and library space to support the temple’s education programs and children’s camps.

How This Helps
The temple: A proper office gives temple staff and volunteers a real place to manage bookings, records, and programs, instead of working out of borrowed space. It’s the quiet infrastructure that lets everything else — from puja bookings to festival planning — run smoothly.

The immediate community: Families whose children attend Bal Vihar, Sadvidya Pathshala, or summer camp benefit directly from a real library and dedicated teaching space, giving children a proper environment to learn scripture, language, and values rather than making do with shared or temporary rooms.

The wider community: A stronger educational foundation helps the temple raise the next generation of community leaders and volunteers, and a real library becomes a resource the whole Central Florida Hindu community can draw on for learning about scripture, culture, and tradition.

title: Help Rebuild a Home After a Devastating Fire
description:
A devastating house fire has left the owner of Shri Shiva Dham Hindu Temple of Orlando facing an overwhelming recovery without homeowners insurance.

For years, she has helped provide a place where families, individuals, and members of the greater Orlando community can come together for worship, cultural programs, celebrations, education, service, and community support. Now, during one of the most difficult moments of her life, we have an opportunity to come together and support her.

Because there is no insurance coverage for the home, the financial responsibility for cleaning up the fire damage, repairing and rebuilding the property, and replacing essential items falls directly on her and her family.

Funds raised through this campaign will help with expenses including:

• Fire and smoke damage cleanup
• Debris removal and disposal
• Structural repairs and reconstruction
• Roofing, electrical, plumbing, and other necessary repairs
• Replacement of damaged building materials
• Smoke and water remediation
• Essential household items and furnishings
• Temporary living and recovery-related expenses
• Other costs directly associated with restoring the home

Every contribution, large or small, can make a meaningful difference.

If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your family, friends, businesses, community organizations, and social networks. The more people who see this campaign, the greater the opportunity we have to help this family recover.

This is more than rebuilding a house. It is about helping someone who has dedicated so much of her time and energy to serving a community rebuild a place she can once again call home.

Thank you for your generosity, compassion, prayers, and support during this difficult time.

Together, we can help rebuild, restore, and bring hope after this devastating fire.
shortDescription: The owner of Shri Shiva Dham Hindu Temple of Orlando suffered a devastating house fire and has no insurance. Please help our community come together to rebuild her home and restore what was lost.
